issues: The inference that people are gathered to hear Sherem is not explicit; the source only says he preached among the people.
Jacob 7:7’s contention identifies the earlier unnamed man as Sherem, but scene 002’s character entry correctly leaves him unnamed; the scene itself is consistent with the preceding chronology.
The verse does not name the speaker; while Sherem is clear from preceding context, labeling him only as “the speaker” is conservative and consistent with the scene’s notes.
The explicit outcome that the people became conquerors is summarized, but no victory is depicted; keep it as reported summary rather than a present-tense battle or victory scene.
The group labels “Lamanites” and “People of Nephi” are supported by the verses, though their visual appearance and the means of fortification are unspecified.
